title: Phantom Blade Zero Physical Edition - PS5 Disc Announced for 2027
description: Digital-only at launch on 29 October 2026, but S-GAME announced in the launch trailer that PS5 physical editions - standard, Deluxe and an Ultimate collector's steelbook - are coming in 2027. What that means if you wanted a disc.

sections.title: Digital on 29 October, Disc in 2027
sections.content:
Phantom Blade Zero launches digitally on 29 October 2026 for PlayStation 5, Steam and the Epic Games Store. There is no disc you can buy that day.

That changed on 21-22 October 2026. S-GAME's launch trailer announced that PS5 physical editions are coming in 2027: a standard edition, a Deluxe edition, and an Ultimate edition in a collector's steelbook. Coverage from Gematsu, 3DM and 4Gamer all carry the same three tiers, so this is a confirmed announcement rather than a rumour.

What the announcement does not give you is a date. "Expected 2027" is the whole of the published information: no month, no price, no pre-order window, and no statement about whether the boxed version needs a day-one patch. If you were waiting for a disc, you are now waiting for a second release roughly a year after the first.

In the meantime the practical consequence is unchanged: you need about 135 GB free on the console and a working download on day one, because there is no disc to install from while a patch downloads.

sections.title: What happened at Play-Asia
sections.content:
Before this announcement, Play-Asia - a retailer that commonly stocks Asian imports - had listed a physical edition and then removed that listing, reportedly after being told a physical version would not be available.

That sequence is why the 2027 news should be read carefully rather than as a reversal: a boxed version appears to have been planned earlier, cancelled, and is now announced again for a different year. The honest summary of the record is that a physical release exists as an announcement now, and nothing about it - not the date, not the editions' contents, not the regions - has been published in enough detail to plan a purchase.

Correction kept visible. This page previously stated that no physical edition had ever been announced and that any store page claiming a boxed copy should be treated as stale. That was accurate up to the launch trailer, and it is wrong now. The claim was based on the absence of any announcement, which is a weaker position than it sounded - absence of news is not a denial.

sections.title: If you want to collect something
sections.content:
The Digital Deluxe Edition is the only premium tier, and it is worth being clear about what it is: the two extra outfits (Wulin Legend and Blood-Steel Form), a digital artbook and the digital soundtrack. That is the digital Deluxe. The announced 2027 physical tiers are separate: standard, Deluxe, and an Ultimate edition in a collector's steelbook. S-GAME has not published what the physical Deluxe and Ultimate editions contain beyond the case, so nobody should quote contents for them yet.

Both editions also carry the pre-order unlocks - the Treasure Basin accessory and the Legacy outfit - and S-GAME's own store copy states that pre-order content can be obtained through playing. The two Deluxe outfits are labelled exclusive, which is a separate question the official page does not settle.

A note on what this page leaves out. The Chinese and Japanese store pages list these bonus items under localised names, but this page does not reproduce them: no second source has confirmed the exact character forms we would print, and inventing or half-remembering a product name is how incorrect names spread across this niche. The English names above are the ones recorded against the official product page and the Steam listing on 2026-10-16, and they are logged with that date on the news page.

sections.title: Why this question keeps coming up
sections.content:
Comment-volume analysis around the trailer coverage put roughly a third of the week's discussion on the missing disc, heavily concentrated in Spanish-language communities, in the form of "no disc, no buy". That is a real segment of the audience, not a rounding error, and it is the reason this page exists rather than being buried in an FAQ.

The related searches tell the same story: "physical", "physical release", "physical copy", "ps5 physical copy" and "steelbook" all appear among the rising queries for the game, alongside retailer names. Every one of them is asking the same question, and the answer used to be a flat no. It is now "not at launch, yes eventually, probably 2027" - which is a worse answer for a buyer who wanted the disc on release day and a better one for anyone who would rather wait.

sections.title: What Is Still Unknown
sections.content:
• When in 2027 the disc actually ships. Announced as expected 2027, with no date, price or region list published.
  • What the physical Deluxe and Ultimate editions include. Only the existence of an Ultimate collector's steelbook has been stated; contents are unpublished.
  • Day-one patch size. The 134.857 GB figure is from the store listing before any launch update, so the real day-one requirement is unknown.
